name: The Widow of Nain
title: Mother of the Raised Young Man
summary: The widow from Nain had lost her only son. When Jesus met the funeral procession at the city gate, he was deeply moved with compassion for her, touched the bier and raised the dead man to life, giving him back to his mother.

keyEvents.title: The Son is Raised from the Dead
keyEvents.description: Jesus had compassion on the grieving widow and raised her only son from the dead at the city gate of Nain.
